eps.o: Since Dale caught the sniffles on the big acorn hunt day, Mickey and Pals help Chip gather acorns with Professor Von Drake's Nifty Nutty Acorn Collector.
Mickey and pals do outdoor chores using Mouseketools to tidy the Clubhouse yard. After cleaning, they enjoy a fun pool party to end the day together.
Minnie, Daisy and Goofy attend Clarabelle's Princess School where they learn princesses are strong, clever and brave.
Little Helper gets locked inside Minnie's Clubhouse with Pluto. When the gang searches for their missing pals, they find that Little Helper and Pluto had a fun day of mischief.
Minnie goes on a big adventure to rescue Mickey on Friendship Day.
When Goofy accidentally builds his new Clubhouse upside down, he, Mickey and Minnie must travel to Magic Island to collect a magic potion that will turn it right side up again!
Mickey and his pals celebrate Halloween on Magic Island, where Witch Clarabelle invites them to do her Haunted Halloween Hunt for a special surprise at the end!
